title: Party, sector, terms: short lines, bigger type
why: UI step 7 (restyle only). Critic scored 05, 06, 07 at 2 for explaining paragraphs and 13px text. Q8 allows shortening with the reason logged.
now: The party and sector pages lose their explaining sentences and the party and terms text is larger.

edits.anchor: Up to four pillagers, linked by invite code. The others in your party walk the Undercroft floor with you, with their names over their heads, and when the host takes the party up, everyone ascends into the same raid.
edits.replacement: Up to four pillagers, one invite code.

edits.anchor: >TRADING. Up top: open the backpack, pick the item and press Z (Y on a controller) to drop it at your feet; your teammate searches the pile like any box. In the Undercroft: right-click a stash item (Y on a controller) and choose Drop on the floor; your teammate walks to the crate and presses E (A on a controller).
edits.replacement: >Trade: drop it on the floor, your teammate picks it up.
